cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.
